title: Obligation coverage (one per node)
description: Records which obligations of a node's cited clause digest(s) its fixture vectors exercise. A sidecar: fixture bytes and golden hashes never move because of it. Enforced by scripts/check-obligation-coverage.mjs gate O2 (coverage is real) and gate O4 (digests still cited); this schema documents the contract and its required[] is drift-pinned by the gate selftest.

node_id.description: The node's tool_id; the fixtures file chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/<node_id>.fixtures.json supplies the vector evidence.

clause_digests.description: A list, not a single digest: 65 percent of citing shards cite more than one digest (OBLIGATION-PREMISE-1, P5). Every entry must still be cited by the node's shard (O4).

accept.description: Vectors whose expected verdict is positive under this obligation.

refuse.description: Vectors whose expected verdict is negative or a refusal because of this obligation.

signal.description: Optional dot path into output_payload carrying the obligation-scoped verdict (for example a per-trigger boolean). Default when absent: non-empty compliance_flags is positive, empty is negative.

covers.description: Obligation id to evidence. An obligation is covered when it has at least one accept and one refuse vector; total coverage is gate O3's concern (a later row), not O2's.

reason.description: Plain statement of scope; prints as the node's honest-limits line in a later row.
Why no vector exercises this obligation yet. Uncovered is a defect, not a scope statement; each uncovered obligation becomes its own row (add a vector, implement the branch, or declare out of scope).

uncovered.description: Obligations with neither vectors nor an out-of-scope declaration. Explicit here so missed branches are visible in the file itself; gate O3 (nothing uncovered, advisory for existing nodes) lands in a later row.
